scope: live near-UV Fe products in data/products/solar/Fe.json
standard: REPORT-AND-NOTE. RYA-777: VIS baseline, do not chase the dragon in IR/UV. RYA-813: near-UV is reported, not validated to target.

Fe I.pool_exhausts_LAB_resource: 58 of the 59 LAB Fe I lines that exist in band

Fe II.per_line_artifact: ABSENT — no *_lines.csv committed for this ion/band; tier composition unmeasurable

_telluric_no_op_in_band.verdict: no registered telluric band reaches this window, so the two holdings cannot differ here by telluric treatment

F1_the_gf_floor_premise_does_not_apply_t.detail: RYA-1113 expects a ~84% Kurucz-floored gf to dominate. The near-UV LINE LIST is indeed overwhelmingly non-LAB (Fe I 59/4274 = 1% LAB; Fe II 12/665 = 2%), but the DEEPGRADED products use only the LAB subset: Fe I 58/58 LAB, measured on the lambda+EP key. The floor is a fact about the band, not about these products.
F1_the_gf_floor_premise_does_not_apply_t.consequence: the gf term here is a MEASURED RMS of published per-line laboratory sigma (0.0509 dex, Fe I), not a floor bound

F2_the_dominant_term_is_a_band_flat_decl.severity: the bar's largest component is not measured per product
F2_the_dominant_term_is_a_band_flat_decl.detail: `pseudo-continuum` = 0.1 dex flat, charged wherever BandPolicy.continuum_treatment is pseudo. Identical for both ions, both holdings, every window. It dominates all eight products, so sigma_syst is effectively a band constant: 0.1122 on every Fe I product and 0.1095 on every Fe II.
F2_the_dominant_term_is_a_band_flat_decl.why_it_matters: a band-flat term cannot distinguish a well-normalised window from a badly-normalised one, and cannot move when the evidence says it should — see F3

F3_the_holdings_disagree_by_more_than_th.severity: 🔴 the measured continuum disagreement exceeds its own budget
F3_the_holdings_disagree_by_more_than_th.detail: Fe II: the two holdings return 7.957 vs 7.697 on the SAME 12 lines — 0.260 dex apart, half-spread 0.130 > the 0.10 bound. Fe I is consistent (0.046 apart, half-spread 0.023). The two holdings are DIFFERENT SOURCE SPECTRA (Kurucz 2005 irradiance vs the 1984 atlas + molecfit), and molecfit corrects no telluric band inside 3000-3780 A, so in this band the difference is continuum realisation and spectrum, not telluric.

_telluric_no_op_in_band.verdict: no registered telluric band reaches this window, so the two holdings cannot differ here by telluric treatment

F4_neither_holding_was_normalisation_pro.detail: RYA-1030's intake probes report 'normalised' for both holdings — but at 4758/6500/8242/9288 A (kurucz2005) and 5482/7980/10478/11976 A (molecfit). Not one probe window lies in 3000-3780 A. The normalisation status of the band these products are measured in is UNPROBED on both holdings.
F4_neither_holding_was_normalisation_pro.note: read from data/catalog/holdings_manifest_registry.csv; RYA-929 is not re-run here, per the ticket

F5_the_NLTE_leg_changes_the_POOL_not_jus.severity: 🔴 the published NLTE effect is confounded with a pool change
F5_the_NLTE_leg_changes_the_POOL_not_jus.detail: Fe II ENGINE-A reports n=7 where its 1D-LTE sibling reports n=12 — 5 of 12 lines dropped, on BOTH holdings. The published difference (+0.018 kurucz2005, +0.041 molecfit) is therefore not a paired NLTE differential: it is 7 lines compared against 12. sigma_stat rises accordingly (0.096->0.1329, 0.0986->0.121), which is the pool shrinking, not the measurement worsening.

F6_no_per_line_artifact_for_Fe_II_in_ban.detail: data/results/band_products/ ships *_lines.csv for Fe I near-UV (molecfit) only. Fe II near-UV has *_products.csv alone, so its tier composition, its rejections and the identity of the 5 lines the NLTE leg drops cannot be interrogated from the committed tree.

F7_no_stellar_parameter_term_reaches_the.detail: same omission RYA-1112 recorded for VIS. sigma_syst here carries pseudo-continuum, gf scale, scatter and harness residual — no Teff/logg/xi term. RYA-1120 built the join; these products predate its application.

no_values_changed: READ-ONLY. This script reads the feed, the band artifacts, canonical_gf and the stellar budget. It writes one audit artifact and changes no value, line, gf or threshold (RYA-161).

products.rca_verdict: OPEN (continuum realisation exceeds its own bound)
products.rca_note: the two holdings disagree by +0.237 dex on the SAME 7 lines, so half-spread 0.118 > the 0.1 pseudo-continuum bound charged here. They are different source spectra (Kurucz 2005 irradiance vs the 1984 atlas) and molecfit corrects no telluric band in 3000-3780 A, so this is continuum + spectrum, not telluric. The bound is band-flat and cannot express it. NOT tuned: the published bars stand; the term needs re-deriving on this evidence.
products.xi_applicability: APPLIES — and is ABSENT. No stellar-parameter term reaches sigma_syst here (same omission RYA-1112 found in VIS, F1). Fe II has no row in the stellar budget at all, so it has no sourced delta_xi to fold even in principle.

products.rca_verdict: IRREDUCIBLE (pseudo-continuum floor on an exhausted lab-gf pool)
products.rca_note: dominated by the 0.1 dex pseudo-continuum systematic, which does not average down: the near-UV true continuum is never observed. The line lever is already spent -- 58 of the 59 LAB Fe I lines that exist in band -- so more/better lines cannot reduce this. Reducing it needs a real continuum determination in band, which is RYA-929/1027 territory, not a tuning knob.
